youtube.title: Switching to contact lenses? Do this first 👁️✨ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Thinking of contact lenses? Get an eye test first.
காண்டாக்ட் லென்ஸ் போடுவதற்கு முன் கண் பரிசோதனை அவசியம்!

• Contact lens power can differ from glasses power, because the lens sits on the eye.
• We stock Acuvue, Bausch+Lomb, Alcon, CooperVision and Freshlook.
• Daily, monthly and coloured lenses: we help you pick what suits your eyes and routine.
• Wash and dry hands, use fresh solution every time, never sleep or swim in lenses.
• Never rinse lenses or the case with tap water.
• Red, painful or blurry eye: remove the lens and see an eye specialist urgently.
• Eye test in our store is free.

gmb.text: Thinking of switching to contact lenses? Start with an eye test, because contact lens power can be different from glasses power. At LenzKare we stock Acuvue, Bausch+Lomb, Alcon, CooperVision and Freshlook, including daily, monthly and coloured lenses, and we help you choose what suits your eyes and routine. Follow the golden rules: wash and dry your hands, use fresh solution every time, never sleep or swim in your lenses, and never let tap water touch your lenses or case. If your eye turns red, painful or blurry, remove the lens and see an eye specialist urgently. The eye test in our store is free. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998

threads.text: Contact lens wearers: be honest, have you ever napped with your lenses in? 😅 It's one of the biggest infection risks, along with tap water. We stock Acuvue, Bausch+Lomb, Alcon, CooperVision and Freshlook, but an eye test always comes first. Glasses or contacts, which team are you? #ContactLenses #EyeCare
